purpose: AI gate for direct publication of source-grounded Psychology learning content.
decision: Publish only when every generated learning package passes the AI audit and all deterministic structural checks.
critical_failures: fabricated PYQ, researcher, experiment, statistic or citation
active recall answer not taught by the package
content unrelated to the canonical micro-topic
cross-reference points to a nonexistent or self-referential micro-topic
cross-reference is unsupported or materially misleading
publish_rule: Publish each package independently when that package passes the AI audit and deterministic checks. Packages that still fail after two rewrite attempts are queued for owner approval; a failed package must not block unrelated packages that pass.
